videos.desc: A young man kills time at night in a room lined with big washing machines and dryers: he slumps on the steel folding counter, slides a coin about, checks the wall clock and finally stretches out flat across the plastic waiting chairs.

A girl crosses the city step by step: she grabs a croissant and coffee, walks wet streets, swipes through the subway turnstile, rides the train, fights with a broken umbrella in the rain and climbs long stairs until she reaches a rooftop view at sunset and says it was worth it.
videos.said: Gotta eat something first or I seriously won't make it. I really hope this is the right train. Okay, looks right. Of course it's raining. Almost there. But it was worth it.

videos.desc: An animated shopping centre with polished floors, glass shopfronts and bright ceiling lights. A woman in a gold dress walks hand in hand with a very large, heavily built man in a white T-shirt and white shorts. She spots a gold dress on a mannequin in a lit shop window, spins round and pulls him towards it. Her face fills the screen, beaming with excitement; then his face fills the screen, eyebrows raised and mouth open in dismay. In the last shot she strides out of the shop holding a fan of pink and white bags while he trudges behind her with both hands full of shopping bags.

A wide, wet stone plaza in Paris at sunset, with the Eiffel Tower rising straight ahead across the river and the columns of a large building on the right. A cream-coloured classic Porsche 911 stands alone on the empty paving in the foreground while the camera drifts slowly sideways past it. The orange sky is full of cloud, a flock of birds turns above the tower, and a few distant people stand at the far edge of the square.

A busy shopping street lined with shops. A woman in a mustard coat walks past a window plastered with big red SALE posters without turning her head; an older man in a tan jacket walks past the same window looking straight ahead. In the doorway a salesman in a suit leans out smiling and stretches an arm towards the passing shoppers, but the stream of people with their coffee cups and carrier bags keeps walking straight past him, nobody meeting his eye. In the last shot the camera pulls back to the wide shop front with SALE signs in both windows and the salesman sitting alone on a stool in the empty doorway.

A woman in a red beret, a striped top and dark jeans, carrying a baguette under her arm, walks from one side of a narrow Paris street to the other over the white stripes on the road, past a red-awninged cafe. The shot then cuts to a wide boulevard in front of the Arc de Triomphe, where she walks the whole width of the road with a crowd of other people while the light is green and the cars wait, and steps up onto the far side.

A Paris street corner with a red-awninged cafe and a cyclist waiting. A woman in a red beret and a striped top, holding a baguette, walks towards the camera along the broad white bars painted across the road, with the pedestrian light green beside her. The shot then cuts to the wide bar-painted crossing in front of the Arc de Triomphe, filled with people walking across in both directions, and she walks up the middle of it towards the camera.

A Japanese city street. A woman in a coral trouser suit with a white shoulder bag walks across the white-barred crossing towards the camera while a black van waits at the red light and the walk signal shows green; other people on foot cross the side street behind her. The camera then rises high above a huge scramble junction, showing her alone in the middle of the painted bars, and finally the same junction with hundreds of people on foot streaming across it in every direction while the cars stand still.

A young woman on a sunlit paved terrace outside a house holds an empty stemmed glass up to the camera and smiles. In close-up, orange juice is poured from a jug into the glass until it is full, standing on a pale stone table beside plates and a second jug. The shot widens: the woman and a young man sit at the laid table on the terrace, oleander bushes and a low wall behind them, and raise their glasses of juice towards the camera.

A young man in a white shirt stands in front of the Trevi Fountain holding an open photo book up against the carved figures and the green water, sits on stone steps turning its bright-tabbed pages, then stands at an iron railing above the city and holds the book up beside a great domed church on the skyline before hugging the book to his chest and smiling at the view.

A young woman in a navy T-shirt sits smiling in the stands of a baseball stadium; the camera pulls back over row after row of seated fans in caps and team shirts, past a packed lower tier, and rises into a wide shot of the whole bowl filled with spectators to the very top.

An aerial shot looking down on a wide, sunlit paved plaza in front of a glass building. At first single people walk across the tiles in every direction, casting long shadows. More and more people arrive, and the loose scattering turns into a dense mass that packs together in the middle of the square until the paving is barely visible.

A young woman in a green satin robe stands at a floor-to-ceiling hotel window with the outline of a whole city of tower blocks stretching away behind her under a pale sky. Holding an open bronze powder compact in one hand, she sweeps a make-up brush high on her cheekbone, then along the bridge of her nose and her brow, and finally under her chin, checking herself between strokes with wide eyes and an open mouth. At the end she lowers the brush, smiles at the camera and holds the compact up beside her face.

A price-ladder tour of homes. An old man in a cardigan stands at a garden gate and waves toward a battered wooden hut behind him, caption 10,000 EUR. Cut to a young couple walking up the path of a detached white suburban house with a black door and a mown front lawn. Cut to a woman in a cream suit opening the door of a modern architect house, then presenting a huge glass villa with a long black reflecting pool and fountain, caption 5,000,000 EUR.

Three homes shown in turn. An old man in a flat cap holds the plank door of a small single-story wooden cottage with a tin roof and a stove pipe, a tall sunflower beside it. Cut to a couple in matching tan jackets walking hand in hand up the path of a white weatherboard cottage with a red front door and clipped hedges, then a blonde woman presenting the same row of cottages with an open arm. Cut to a woman in a white suit standing in the doorway of a black glass mansion behind a still reflecting pool with palm trees.

A young man films himself walking through a busy Turkish street market. He holds an orange up to the camera and grins, then passes a fishmonger working beside large hanging scale pans over trays of iced fish. He walks on past barrels of green olives carrying a mesh bag of oranges, and finally walks down the long vaulted aisle of a covered spice bazaar, with rows of stalls piled high with coloured spices on both sides of him.

A woman with a large hiking backpack walks through an old North African medina, following a map on her phone. She turns down a very narrow lane between tall ochre and blue walls, close enough to touch both sides, checking the screen and pointing at it. She keeps walking, squeezes past a man standing in the lane, then passes through a covered market passage hung with clothes and lined with stalls, and out through a low brick archway. At the end she comes out into a huge open square in front of a mosque with a tall minaret, looks at her phone again and smiles.

A young man in round glasses, a denim jacket and a backpack stands in a narrow aisle of a packed bookshop, tall shelves of books on both sides of him and knee-high stacks of new titles on the floor. He holds a thick hardback open in both hands and lets the pages riffle past his face, mouth open in amazement. He turns a pink-jacketed book over, flips through a second heavy volume, then hugs an enormous oversized book to his chest. At the end he holds a huge book open above his head and looks up as the pages fan out over him.
videos.said: Oh! Oh! Aha! Oh! Oh! Oh! Oh! Whoa!

videos.desc: On a narrow town street at golden hour a woman edges a small blue hatchback into a tight kerbside gap between a white car in front and another car behind, leaning out of the open driver's window as she manoeuvres. The car settles into the gap beside the paved pavement, with shop fronts and cafe tables behind it. She then gets out, shuts the door and walks away along the pavement in the low sun.

An older man in denim overalls stands on a stepladder outside a clapboard house and pins a string of red, white and blue triangular bunting under the porch roof, then hangs a large striped flag beside the front door. A wider shot shows the same thing happening along the whole street: other men on ladders at their own porches, flags on the houses opposite, and a small child with painted cheeks running across the front lawn behind a wooden picket fence. In the last shots the man stands on the pavement in the middle of the decorated street, bunting strung above him and neighbours waving from the gardens on both sides, and puts his hand flat on his chest.

On a cobbled street in a hillside quarter of brightly painted houses, a young man in a yellow vest keeps a football up with his foot while a bigger man in a dark T-shirt watches him. People come out of the doorways and windows of the houses around them and a game starts in the middle of the street, with folded shirts and a small metal frame for goals and women watching from balconies and doorsteps. It ends with all the players running together into one laughing huddle in the road.

A selfie-POV clip through a Portuguese city. A young man holds the camera at arm's length while riding on the open step of a yellow tram down a steep narrow street at sunset. Next he walks along a building whose whole facade is covered in blue-and-white painted tiles; he presses his palm flat against them and looks up the wall. Then he is at a marble cafe table, breaking into a sugar-dusted custard tart with a fork beside an espresso, and eating it with a delighted look at the camera.

A young man in a denim jacket with orange headphones round his neck walks along a city pavement past parked cars while a cyclist rides by. He reaches the corner where two streets cross, marked by a fire hydrant and chalk drawings on the paving, then steps out over the striped crossing into the middle of the busy junction, passing other pedestrians before walking on past cafe tables under red umbrellas.

A young woman in a beige trench coat with long braids walks along a palm-lined street in a hot, sunny Gulf city, tipping her head back to look up. Behind her rises a huge curved glass residential tower, and the clip ends on a slow tilt up the mirrored flanks of an enormous spire-topped skyscraper against the blue sky.
